metabolic_screening.label: Newborn Metabolic Screening (blood spot)
metabolic_screening.state_form_note: Nebraska law mandates screening for all newborns; no opt-out provision. Law has been challenged in court and upheld.
metabolic_screening.midwife_role: Educate parents on screening benefits and risks; if parent declines, obtain signed refusal/opt-out form per state requirements and file in newborn's record.
metabolic_screening.declination_law: Neb. Rev. Stat. Â§Â§ 71-519 to 71-524 â newborn screening is mandatory; no religious or personal exemption

hearing_screening.label: Newborn Hearing Screening
hearing_screening.state_form_note: Hearing screening opt-out rules vary; in most states hearing screening refusal is documented separately from blood spot refusal. Check state-specific requirements.
hearing_screening.midwife_role: Arrange hearing screening per state protocol; document refusal if parent declines.
hearing_screening.declination_law: Hearing screening refusal documented in medical record per state practice.

cchd_screening.label: CCHD Pulse Oximetry Screening
cchd_screening.state_form_note: CCHD screening is part of the newborn screening panel; refusal documented via the same form as blood spot screening where applicable.
cchd_screening.midwife_role: Perform or refer for pulse-ox screening; document refusal if parent declines.
cchd_screening.declination_law: CCHD screening refusal follows the same process as metabolic screening refusal in states with a unified form.

erythromycin_eye_ointment.label: Erythromycin Eye Ointment (newborn eye prophylaxis)
erythromycin_eye_ointment.state_form_note: Eye prophylaxis refusal documented via informed refusal/waiver in medical record; no standalone state form in most states.
erythromycin_eye_ointment.midwife_role: Administer eye prophylaxis per state law unless parent declines; document signed informed refusal.
erythromycin_eye_ointment.declination_law: State law requires eye prophylaxis; refusal documented via informed refusal in medical record.

vitamin_k.label: Vitamin K (oral or injection)
vitamin_k.program: Informed choice â no state form
vitamin_k.state_form_note: Vitamin K is an informed choice; no state-specific opt-out form required.
vitamin_k.midwife_role: Three-way informed choice (oral / shot / none) documented in records; shot administered by midwife or referred.
vitamin_k.declination_law: No state mandate; informed choice per clinical standards.

hepatitis_b_vaccine.label: Hepatitis B Vaccine (birth dose)
hepatitis_b_vaccine.state_form_note: Hepatitis B birth dose consent or declination documented in writing; state-specific immunization exemption laws may apply separately.
hepatitis_b_vaccine.midwife_role: Birth-dose consent or declination documented in writing; administered dose reported to state immunization registry.
hepatitis_b_vaccine.declination_law: State immunization exemption laws apply; declination documented in medical record.

gestational_diabetes.label: Gestational Diabetes Screening (prenatal)
gestational_diabetes.program: Informed choice â no state form
gestational_diabetes.state_form_note: Prenatal informed choice; midwife refers out for glucose testing when declined.
gestational_diabetes.midwife_role: Prenatal informed choice; midwife refers out for glucose testing when declined.
gestational_diabetes.declination_law: No state mandate for gestational diabetes screening form; informed choice per clinical standards.

group_b_strep.label: Group B Strep Screening & Prophylaxis (prenatal)
group_b_strep.program: Informed choice â no state form
group_b_strep.state_form_note: Prenatal informed choice per ACOG/CDC; swab testing via referral or in-office; intrapartum antibiotics referred if opted-in.
group_b_strep.midwife_role: Prenatal informed choice per ACOG/CDC; swab testing via referral or in-office; intrapartum antibiotics referred if opted-in.
group_b_strep.declination_law: No state mandate for GBS screening form; informed choice per clinical standards.
